label: An intellectual, willing cause of the being of all directs everything else to an end
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1) and will (HAS_WILL_1) and causes the being of every other being in act as to being (IsCreatorOfAll) directs each other being in act as to being to some end (Directs g x e, the quinta via / q.103 relation). After ST I q.22 a.2: every agent acts for an end, and the ordering of effects to that end extends as far as the causality of the first agent extends. Restricted to a cause of the being of ALL others: for a particular cause, effects outside its intention arise from the concurrence of other causes (q.22 a.2 ad 1), which a cause of the being of everything else does not meet. It does not say how the direction is carried out (immediately or through intermediaries, q.103 a.6), nor that the end is the same for all. Control part 4: without it, a being with the nine directs and governs nothing and is not LORD_2.
